page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-1xL4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 20 shared vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 12.8 GB per vCPU. The server does not include local storage, meaning storage must be provisioned externally. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The primary accelerator on this instance is a single NVIDIA L4 GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture. This GPU is equipped with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. The inclusion of this hardware makes the server suitable for workloads requiring parallel processing capabilities, such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, and graphics rendering.

Because the 20 vCPUs are allocated on a shared basis, CPU-bound performance may vary depending on host node utilization. However, the high memory capacity of 256.0 GB paired with the dedicated 24 GB VRAM of the NVIDIA L4 GPU provides a resource-dense environment. This configuration is designed for memory-intensive GPU workloads, data science tasks, and AI model deployment where massive system memory is required alongside hardware acceleration.
